knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The trainer checks the permit and uses only the designated area unless the permit allows more.
The trainer stops, moves the group to shelter, and records the decision and time. The booking does not override the conditions.
The lesson says the Stonnington listing states that training may run only between 6am and 9pm.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks a sample park permit and confirms the candidate identifies the designated area, the time window and the group size limit
Assessor observes the candidate complete a site inspection of a simulated park and record at least three hazards
Assessor presents a simulated storm or heat warning sign and observes the candidate stop, move the group and record the decision
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Council permit copy with the designated area and conditions identified
Site inspection record with the hazards and conditions
Session record showing the stop and the end time
stopWorkCriteria: A session is run outside the designated area or the permit hours
A session continues in a storm or with a participant showing a warning sign
